title: Obi-Wan Kenobi
description: Exiled to Tatooine after the purge of the Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi's sole job was to watch over young Luke Skywalker to ensure his protection and safety. Living in a cave and adopting the name "Ben", his connection to the Force shattered through his grief over the galaxy and the fate of his former Padawan. But still he stood sentinel over the son of Skywalker, no matter how many times Owen Lars told him to go away. When he received a transmission from Bail Organa explaining that Luke's sister was missing, he had a difficult choice to make...
